title: 6 x 1966 ROUND 50 CENT COINS
findings: Six round Australian 50 cent coins, Coat of Arms reverse, consistent with 1966 (80% silver, about 13.3g fine silver each, about 80g silver in total). Dates are on the obverse, which is not shown, so the 1966 claim cannot be checked but the round 50c was only issued in 1966.
condition: Circulated; one coin heavily toned gold-brown; light wear and marks.
reason: About 80g of fine silver in 1966 round 50c coins; bullion value plus collector demand.
marks_read: 50 Coat of Arms reverse, obverses not shown

title: 2 STERLING SILVER CASED POCKET...
description: 2 STERLING SILVER CASED POCKET WATCHES - AS IS
findings: Two silver full hunter or open-faced pocket watches with enamel Roman dials and subsidiary seconds. Inside case lid of the right watch shows a small hallmark cartouche (not legible at this resolution). Left dial has a small maker's line near VI, not legible. Backs engine turned with vacant cartouches. Likely Victorian/Edwardian English or Swiss silver key-wind or lever watches.
condition: As is: one bow missing its ring on the right watch; dial wear and hairlines; left dial looks chipped near seconds; not known to run.
reason: Two sterling-cased pocket watches, silver weight and parts value, possibly a decent English lever movement.

interest.note: 2 silver-cased pocket watches, as is, enamel dials, makers not legible

title: SHEET OF AUSTRALIAN FLORINS
findings: Sheet of 40 Australian florins: about half are George V and early George VI pre-1946 sterling (92.5%, about 10.5g fine silver each), dates read include 1923-1936 era types and 1938-1946 George VI; post-1946 50% silver Elizabeth II types to about 1960; includes two 1951 Jubilee florins and two 1954 Royal Visit florins. Total silver content probably 300g or more fine silver. No key dates seen at this resolution (1932, 1933 can't be confirmed).
condition: Circulated, mixed grades, some toning; housed in plastic album sheet.
reason: 40 silver florins, well over 300g of fine silver, bullion value alone likely over $300.
marks_read: florin dates partly legible: 1923-36 GV, 1938-46 GVI, 1951 Jubilee, 1954 Royal Visit, 1950s EII
